scope: Unified shift lifecycle, role-aware attendance, checkout lock, badge consistency. Mock-only localStorage Next.js 16 MVP, no backend.

details.reason: Fix requires a Next.js major downgrade. Build-time CSS tooling, not an app runtime input path. Carried over from CS6/7/8/9; no deps added by CS10.

findings.observation: Mark-present/absent/revert are only on the employer RoleGuard'd shift detail (404 unless shift.employerId === currentUserId). The worker dashboard has no such action.
findings.test: code review; employer detail ownership guard

findings.observation: Worker self check-in stamps the worker's own checkInAt. Employer markPresentByEmployer sets markedPresentAt only, never checkInAt, so it cannot impersonate the worker nor unlock checkout.
findings.test: src/__tests__/coreStability10.test.ts (employer-marked-present never unlocks checkout); coreStability8.test.ts (mark-present != checkInAt)

findings.area: Employer cannot mark attendance for another employer's shift
findings.observation: Employer shift detail returns notFound() when shift.employerId !== currentUserId, so attendance actions are unreachable for a non-owned shift.

findings.area: Direct action cannot bypass the checkout time gate
findings.observation: canCheckOut enforces now>=end + CheckedIn + own checkInAt in the domain layer; the lifecycle badge is display-only and opens no action path.

findings.area: Notification deeplink cannot bypass the checkout time gate
findings.observation: A deeplink only navigates; checkout availability is recomputed from the wall clock on render. A pre-end deeplink cannot surface a checkout button.

findings.area: Lifecycle state cannot be spoofed via the client
findings.observation: The lifecycle badge is a pure projection of (shift, applications, now); there is no stored grant to forge. localStorage editing only affects the user's own demo data (universal mock limitation).

knownLimitations: Mock-only: all authorization is client-side; a user can edit localStorage via devtools. Real server-side authz is the Phase 1 backend deliverable (backend-migration-plan.md).
Clearing browser storage loses all runtime data (disclosed site-wide in the footer).
